Remark
[Simplifying the hodograph system via a potential function] ↗ ex:hodograph-transform-irrotational-flow 1. ch4:4.4.3-rem-1\group Nonlinear to Linear PDE

Writing $x^1=z_{u_1}$ and $x^2=z_{u_2}$ reduces the hodograph system to \[ (\sigma ^2-u_1^2)z_{u_2u_2}+2u_1u_2z_{u_1u_2} +(\sigma ^2-u_2^2)z_{u_1u_1}=0. \]
